quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 2.643 billion (+35.58% YoY); total profit RMB 667 million (+21.26%); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 563 million (+11.44%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 516 million (+12.04%). Revenue growth came from rising CMP market share and sales plus strong momentum in thinning, ion implant, wet, wafer reclaim, consumables and service businesses. Inventory rose 24.69% to RMB 4.974 billion (raw materials and work in progress up sharply); contract liabilities RMB 2.062 billion; operating cash flow fell 81.44% on higher purchase payments and payroll.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 2.643 billion (+35.58%); net profit attributable RMB 563 million (+11.44%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CMP: Universal-300FS entered the supply chain of a leading domestic logic customer with large-volume purchase orders, and some advanced-node CMP tools went into production at more customers; the stacked-architecture Universal-S300 won volume orders from several customers; the first upgraded Universal-S300A was delivered to a leading memory customer for process qualification; Universal-H300 completed volume delivery and acceptance. Several 6/8-inch CMP volume orders were signed, and the panel-level Master-P510APEX (510x515mm, which the company calls China's first fully automatic panel-level CMP production tool) won an order from a core advanced-packaging customer. Cumulative CMP tool shipments passed 1,000 units. New order intake across product lines grew sharply in H1.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Thinning: wafer thinning tools now cover most leading domestic fabs and OSATs; new orders hit a record and backlog is ample, with a first-mover position in 3DIC and HBM applications. New first shipments in H1: Versatile-GH300 12-inch thinning tool for advanced memory (sub-micron precision), Versatile-GN200 for compound wafers, and an 8-inch Versatile-GR200 delivered to an emerging domestic chipmaker. Management: with 3D NAND above 300 layers and HBM moving to 12- and 16-high stacks, wafer thinning has become a core process bottleneck, and integrated grinding-polishing-cleaning thinning tools are becoming mainstream.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ion implant: 12-inch high-current ion implanters are being supplied in volume to several leading domestic IC makers; an iPUMA-LE 12-inch high-current implanter was delivered to a leading domestic advanced-memory company and the first 12-inch low-temperature implanter iPUMA-LT is in customer qualification; repeat and volume orders continue and implant revenue grew steadily. Edge polishing: the 12-inch Master-BN300 won repeat orders from a leading domestic chip company. Wet: the first 8-chamber 12-inch single-wafer cleaner for silicon wafers was delivered to a leading domestic silicon-wafer maker; SDS/CDS slurry supply systems won volume orders from domestic IC customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wafer reclaim: Hwatsing won volume long-term orders from several leading fabs' production lines; the Kunshan reclaim expansion project has completed investment filing and environmental approval, and once fully ramped will lift total reclaim capacity from the Tianjin plant's 200,000 wafers per month to 600,000 wafers per month. A Shanghai R&D, production and service base is also under way.
quarterly_data.figure: Reclaim capacity: Tianjin 20 x 10,000 wafers/month; total 60 x 10,000 wafers/month after Kunshan

quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management view (half-year report): GAA in volume at 3nm has sharply increased the number of CMP steps, and 3D NAND layer counts and HBM packaging require sub-nanometer global planarity; AI compute capex is in a long upcycle; and amid surging demand, core component supply bottlenecks have appeared, with longer lead times for overseas parts opening a window for domestic suppliers.

Hwatsing Technology.why: China's leading CMP equipment maker (over 1,000 CMP tools shipped) also selling thinning tools for 3DIC/HBM, ion implanters and wafer reclaim; sales rise with fab and advanced-packaging capacity additions.
